params.message:
Integration docs served by the app at /docs; Scribe removed

The generated Scribe site under public/docs was off brand and from the previous developer.
The app now renders its own documentation at /docs from markdown in the repository: a hub,
the website embed guide (/docs/website, one screen; /embed/handleiding redirects 301), the
public website API (/docs/api, written from the code) and the partner API (/docs/partner,
ported from the Scribe descriptions and checked against the code). DocsMatchRoutesTest keeps
the endpoint tables and routes/api.php one list. knuckleswtf/scribe removed from composer,
fakerphp/faker kept as a dev dependency for the factory. Rule S2-5.22, finding
partner-api-gebruikers and two open points for Frederik.
